Hi Kimberly,

Before we schedule the technical deep-dive, procurement has asked for a short commercial sketch we can take internally (pilot duration, expected costs, any recommended efficiency levers).

High level: Aperture wants a 3-month pilot to validate latency and unit economics for a chat assistant product. Ballpark usage: ~500k tokens / month in month 1, scaling to ~2M tokens / month by month 3 if performance looks good. Key asks:
- A simple pricing estimate for the pilot and a mid-term committed price if we want to convert to a paid tier
- Recommended quantization & batching settings you expect to use for a 7B-ish open model (we're exploring Llama-2-13B and Mistral 7B variants)
- Any pilot credits or discounts to accelerate the proof-of-value

Can you send a brief note we can share with finance/procurement? Happy to jump on a 30-min call if easier.

Best,

Short version for procurement (shareable):

- Pilot commercial: $6k flat pilot credit + usage at our hosted list rate (see breakdown below). If you commit to a 12mo conversion within 60 days of pilot close, we can offer a conversion discount (15% on per-token usage) and a one-time technical onboarding credit.
- Technical recommendations (7B-class): prefer an aggressive 4-bit quant profile for latency-sensitive reads with selective int8 for critical layers; enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts and 2–4 request concurrency batching for low-latency interactive flows.

Concrete estimate (hosted):
- List per-token: $0.000012 / input token, $0.00006 / output token (model variant dependent)
- Pilot month 1 (500k tokens): est ~$150 (usage) — with $6k pilot credit this is fully covered and will prioritize your traffic on our standard pilot pool
- Pilot ramp to 2M tokens: est ~$600/month (usage) — credit covers all of pilot; conversion pricing will be applied if you choose to move to a committed plan.

I'll attach a short proposal + a technical note on quant/batching. Aditya (solutions) — can you add a recommended config for Mistral 7B + Llama-2-13B variants?

If that looks reasonable I can draft an SOW and a one-page mutual action plan.

Anna / procurement team — quick answers and a proposed commercial path.

Commercial clarifications:
- $6k pilot credit: fixed, applied to pilot billing; if you convert to a committed 12-month contract within 60 days of pilot completion we will apply the remaining credit as a one-time discount on the first invoice (not cumulative against future months).
- Fast-growth concession: if usage exceeds 5M tokens/mo consistently for two consecutive months within 6 months post-conversion, we offer an inbound tier drop of 18% on per-output-token rates starting the month after the threshold is met. We can include an explicit clause in the SOW.

Technical responses (from Aditya, included inline):
- Latency: for the prompt shape you described (150 in / 60 out), Mistral 7B on our hosted runtime with q4_0/4-bit groupwise quant + prefix-KV cache is capable of ~120–180ms p95 when configured with small batch sizes (2–6) and a fast inter-op kernel. Expect p50 ~60–90ms.
- Batching tradeoffs: higher batch sizes (8–16) increase throughput but push p95 above your 220ms target. We recommend adaptive batching: start with max_batch=6, dynamic_time_slicing to prefer latency, and increase for non-interactive backfills.
- Cache: if you have repeated system prompts or template-based prefixes, prefix/KV caching can reduce GPU run-time by ~25–35% for repeated sequences and reduce egress tokens counted by caching heuristics.
- Quant: q4 groupwise offers best latency/cost balance; int8 gives slightly better single-thread latency for some kernels but increases memory and stability risk on a few open variants. For pilot, we prefer q4_0_ks (groupwise 4-bit) with fallback to int8 for the last-layer matmuls on Llama-2-13B variants.

Proposed pilot packaging (SOW sketch):
- Duration: 3 months.
- Pilot operational band: reserved slot on pilot pool (priority routing) + $6k credit.
- Tech deliverables: onboarding, two SE sessions (architecture + tuning), quantization configuration doc, and a post-pilot performance report.
- Conversion option: 12-month committed plan with 15% conversion discount on listed per-token rates; 18% tier drop upon sustained 5M+/month usage as above.

Attachments: I attached a one-page proposal and a technical config note (quant-config-recs.md) with sample config snippets and performance numbers.

Next steps: if procurement signs off on the credit mechanics and tier clause, Grace can draft the SOW and my team will schedule the SE sessions. Suggest 30-min call Fri 7/16 11am PT or Mon 7/19 9am PT.

Thanks — looping Aditya for the tuning plan.

Cheers,
Kimberly
